### Models and Inference Parameters

Five current-generation models were queried through the OpenRouter API between 28 and 31 August 2026: `openai/gpt-5.6-luna`, `anthropic/claude-sonnet-5`, `google/gemini-3.7-flash`, `z-ai/glm-5.3-flash`, and `deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash`.

Every language-model cell was evaluated in every model represented in that dataset, the 32 LLM cells of the exploratory set and the 4 model-bearing cells of the primary set; the model-independent reference cells were executed once.

Each episode was run once per cell per model in the main datasets, because the design is fully paired and repetition estimates model stochasticity rather than adding neural observations; a separate repeated-generation check on two arms is reported in the supplement.
In the analysed data 8,098 retry attempts were made across 141,879 requests, and 3,656 of 50,230 episode runs (7.3%) recorded at least one retry.
